record.title: Salaried individuals — Tax Year 2026
assumptions: Applies to an individual whose income under the head "Salary" exceeds 75% of taxable income (the salaried table). The separate non-salaried/AOP table is out of scope.
Input is ANNUAL TAXABLE income in whole PKR, after any exemptions/deductions. CivicProbe does not model allowances, zakat, or deductions.
Output is annual income tax before tax credits and withholding adjustments.
Super tax (s.4C) is not modelled; its thresholds (≥ Rs. 150 million) lie outside the probed domain.
Includes the s.4AB surcharge (9% of tax where taxable income exceeds Rs. 10,000,000) as it applied to salaried persons in TY2026.
